scope: All dashboard surfaces explicitly classified as operationalActions by the Stage-26 CRUD matrix. Stage 27 verifies real effect, permission/scope, verified step-up where sensitive, retry/idempotency behavior, and visible success/error evidence without reclassifying ordinary CRUD.

contracts.authScope: Every remote operational action inherits authenticated v2 routing plus the surface-specific DEV/global/guild scope. Cross-scope access must fail closed.
contracts.stepUp: Sensitive DEV mutations require server-verified DEV step-up; shape-only reason/reAuth validation is not sufficient.
contracts.idempotency: JSON mutations use the central dashboard API X-Idempotency-Key and v2 idempotency middleware. Action-local keys may add domain replay protection but never replace the central request claim.
contracts.effect: A success response is allowed only when the advertised production side effect is actually coupled. Audit/state-only placeholders are not operational effects.
contracts.resultError: UI must expose bounded pending state plus visible success/error; unavailable operations are hidden or rejected fail-closed instead of reporting false success.

surfaces.actionFamily: DEV session entry/logout and shell-local operational navigation
surfaces.authScope: GlobalDeveloperIdentity plus server-confirmed DEV session; unauthorized and stale client hints fail closed
surfaces.stepUp: DEV session establishment owns its authentication contract; privileged child actions apply their own verified step-up
surfaces.idempotency: Session/logout semantics are bounded by server session lifecycle; no dashboard-data CRUD is claimed
surfaces.effect: Logout revokes/locks the DEV shell; local pin/search actions remain client-only

surfaces.actionFamily: kill.ai, kill.automod, kill.translation, provider.force, maintenance, cache.flush, backup.trigger
surfaces.authScope: GlobalDeveloperIdentity plus requireDev; mutations additionally require cryptographically verified DEV step-up
surfaces.idempotency: Central v2 X-Idempotency-Key plus the legacy domain replay key; unavailable actions cannot reach side effects
surfaces.effect: Repository-wide audit found no production consumer of isIncidentActive and no real cache.flush/backup.trigger side effect. Backend therefore exposes an empty operational allowlist and returns 503 for these actions; UI renders no action buttons.

surfaces.actionFamily: audit/observability query, refresh and export navigation
surfaces.authScope: GlobalDeveloperIdentity/DEV diagnostic scope with redaction and restricted-session fail-closed behavior
surfaces.stepUp: Sensitive exports are delegated to the separately verified secure-export surface
surfaces.idempotency: Read/refresh operations do not mutate production state
surfaces.effect: Returns redacted observability/audit data; no write side effect is claimed by read controls

surfaces.actionFamily: trigger Nitrado mirror snapshot and inspect snapshot progress/content
surfaces.authScope: GlobalDeveloperIdentity plus requireDev; trigger verifies guild restriction and connection ownership
surfaces.idempotency: Central v2 X-Idempotency-Key guards retryable POST; trigger also has a bounded per-actor rate limit
surfaces.effect: startSnapshot creates the real mirror snapshot workflow and responds 202 with snapshotId; failures are visible and audited

surfaces.authScope: GlobalDeveloperIdentity plus requireDev; global-only diagnostic scope fails closed for restricted DEV sessions
surfaces.stepUp: v2 mount requires cryptographically verified DEV step-up before the stub router
surfaces.idempotency: Central v2 X-Idempotency-Key guards POST retry; endpoint is additionally rate-limited for self-DoS protection
surfaces.effect: v8.writeHeapSnapshot writes a real bounded-path snapshot; failure returns 500 and success is audited

surfaces.authScope: GlobalDeveloperIdentity plus requireDev and scoped export contract
surfaces.stepUp: v2 mount requires cryptographically verified DEV step-up
surfaces.idempotency: Raw POST explicitly carries X-Idempotency-Key because streaming/download transport bypasses the JSON client
surfaces.effect: Produces a real bounded export response/download; non-success responses remain visible and do not masquerade as exports

actions.scope: global DEV identity; no guild/games cross-scope write
actions.route: /api/v2/dev/* session logout path per shell contract
actions.stepUpReAuth: not required for logout; login owns credential check
actions.idempotency: session lifecycle; repeated logout is no-op/safe
actions.race: server session is source of truth
actions.errorState: visible toast/error; no false logged-out state without server confirm

actions.scope: global incident toggles (no guild parameter); missing consumer => fail-closed
actions.payload: { action, durationMs?, reason, reAuth, idempotencyKey, payload? }
actions.validation: action in INCIDENT_LIMITS; reason/reAuth via verified step-up; idempotencyKey >= 8
actions.race: already_active => 409; allowlist empty prevents state write
actions.retry: same key replays domain claim; no double effect while unavailable
actions.realSideEffect: NONE in production runtime; isIncidentActive has no consumer
actions.audit: would audit only if allowlisted; currently 503 before service mutation
actions.successState: not offered in UI while operationalActions=[]
actions.residualRisk: service still contains in-memory toggles for future coupling; not API-reachable as success

actions.realSideEffect: NONE — fireOneShotIncident only audits; no cache layer flush consumer
actions.residualRisk: service oneshot remains audit-only until real flush wiring (later stage)
service oneshot remains audit-only until real backup trigger wiring (later stage)

actions.scope: global or restricted DEV session with redaction
actions.audit: read path may emit diagnostic access logs depending on route
actions.mobile: read layout regression covered by observability e2e

actions.authZ: GlobalDeveloperIdentity + requireDev on router; guild restrict enforced
actions.retry: idempotent middleware + visible error on failure
actions.realSideEffect: startSnapshot creates real mirror snapshot workflow + snapshotId
actions.errorState: visible error string; no fake success
actions.mobile: trigger controls in DEV mirror e2e
actions.residualRisk: long-running snapshot resource use (ops, not false-success)

actions.scope: process-local diagnostics; restricted sessions fail closed on diagnostics architecture
actions.validation: shape reason/reAuth + mount crypto step-up; path hardened to cwd/tmpdir
actions.race: sync heap walk; limiter reduces self-DoS
actions.retry: may create additional snapshots if new idempotency key

actions.payload: kind-specific body + reason/reAuth; raw fetch with X-Idempotency-Key
actions.retry: idempotency key protects duplicate claim where middleware applies
actions.errorState: visible non-success; no empty success masquerade
actions.residualRisk: export data sensitivity mitigated by DEV + step-up + scope

classificationNotes.stage26Boundary: Welcome/Goodbye test-send, embed post/repost, feed sync, killfeed sync, bot-admin probe/reset/validate, command deploy and similar mutation-shaped controls remain classified under Stage-26 persistent/ephemeral CRUD surfaces and are regression-covered there; Stage 27 does not reclassify them as operationalActions.
classificationNotes.incidentPolicy: OPTION B applied: fail-closed disable/unadvertise until real runtime consumers exist (no fake success).
